claims.claim: HD 158485 was identified as a binary system with an orbital period of 382.8 days and a companion roughly 80 percent the mass of the primary.
claims.episode_span: Researchers at the Xinjiang Astronomical Observatory identified HD 158485 as a binary while reviewing Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite observations. The two stars orbit every 382.8 days with the companion roughly 80 percent the mass of the primary.
claims.supporting_quote: they orbit each other every 382.8 days

claims.claim: A two-star atmosphere model for HD 158485 showed flux differences of 1.6 percent between one and five micrometers and 2.5 percent between five and 28 micrometers compared with a single-star model.
claims.episode_span: A two-star atmosphere model showed flux differences of 1.6 percent between one and five micrometers and 2.5 percent between five and 28 micrometers compared with a single-star model.
claims.source_title: Astronomers Discover a Hidden Binary in a Star System Used to Calibrate the JWST
claims.supporting_quote: The team further compared a two-star atmosphere model with a conventional single-star model using the system's mass ratio, which showed a flux difference of about 1.6% between one and five micrometers (μm), and 2.5% between five and 28 μm.

claims.claim: The DESTINY model at the University of Liège uses Markov chains with absorbing states to track molecules on amorphous ice surfaces by assigning binding energies to individual sites.
claims.episode_span: Astrophysicists at the University of Liège built the DESTINY model using Markov chains with absorbing states to follow molecules on amorphous ice surfaces. The model assigns binding energies to individual surface sites instead of a single average value.
claims.source_title: DESTINY model tracks molecular chemistry on uneven, ice-covered grains in interstellar space
claims.supporting_quote: The DESTINY model, which we have developed entirely from scratch, overcomes these two simplifications... The model classifies surface sites according to their binding energy and, in a deterministic manner, tracks the possible path of each adsorbed species... Markov chains with absorbing states enable these competing outcomes to be handled in a consistent manner.

claims.claim: The pulsar discovered outside its supernova remnant shell has a transverse velocity above 1,400 kilometers per second.
claims.episode_span: Timing and dispersion measures yielded a transverse velocity above 1,400 kilometers per second.
claims.source_title: Runaway pulsar escapes the remnant of its own supernova
claims.supporting_quote: We estimated its transverse velocity to be over 1,400 kilometers per second (870 miles per second), making it one of the largest values for Milky Way pulsars.

claims.claim: JWST NIRSpec observations of LAP2 placed its oxygen abundance below 0.5 percent of the solar value with a stellar mass of approximately 80,000 solar masses.
